scope.behavior: Fifteen absolute float32 color values and four explicit desktop Auto actions analyze retained source DC and captured selection. Successful native bakes retain the single original GPU display base; a content/mask/history/export boundary stages baked GPU data and ends the session in one rollback-capable transaction.

scratch.qualification: Measured WASM layouts; shared immutable base/mask references do not create another Gaussian/mask payload charge merely by being retained.

admissionPolicy.qualification: Conservative controller allowances cover outer checkpoint plus candidate history-copy overlap. Actual native grants/census enforce admitted payload. Native base/bake/history owners, staged/retired GPU owners, JS copies, GC, allocator/deque metadata, retained WASM pages and driver allocations are not a closed process/GPU/raw-codec quota.

publication.workerPump: Real MessageChannel tasks yield between bounded worker batches; each native request uses 4096 work units, batches stop after 8 ms or 256 steps, and cancellation is checked before each step/progress publication.
publication.finalPublication: Native history/session publication and full GPU materialization can retain synchronous O(N + history) work; this packet makes no blanket responsiveness or performance claim.
publication.rollback: Native scene/history and metadata commit together after admitted browser publication/fence. Rollback advances the metadata epoch while keeping the same physical base; newer local preview revision remains independently guarded.

scope.acceptance: Each final unit/focused/affected-regression/production terminal retains its own counts. Failed or interrupted prior runs do not contribute a passing union. No new complete development cohort is asserted.

limitations: Manual Apply remains a browser control; full desktop automatic slider/numeric commit, deferred pointer replay and Auto/preset hover semantics remain separate gaps.
